title: Mario Golf: Super Rush
description: Golf with a Mushroom Kingdom twist. Hit the green with up to four players locally or online and golf with friends from the Super Mario series like Mario, Peach, Yoshi, and more. Modes range from Standard Golf to the energetic Speed Golf and Battle Golf, while Golf Adventure lets your Mii rise from rookie to pro.

gameplayPillars.title: Speed Golf chaos
gameplayPillars.description: Tee off at the same time and race to finish each hole first while dashing across the course.

gameplayPillars.title: Battle Golf arenas
gameplayPillars.description: Compete in a neon stadium full of hazards like Thwomps, Chain Chomps, and banana peels.

gameplayPillars.title: Golf Adventure progression
gameplayPillars.description: Train a Mii golfer, improve stats, and take on a structured campaign at Bonny Greens.

gameplayPillars.title: Speed Golf and Battle Golf
gameplayPillars.description: Alternative modes such as Speed Golf and Battle Golf turn standard golf into a faster, more chaotic race for holes, power-ups, and map control.

gameplayPillars.title: Character progression in Golf Adventure
gameplayPillars.description: The single-player Golf Adventure mode lets a Mii improve stats, learn mechanics, and move through themed courses and training sequences.

worldSummary: Mario Golf: Super Rush blends arcade-style Mushroom Kingdom personality with accessible golf systems, fast-paced competitive modes, and a light RPG-like adventure structure for the Mii campaign.

storyChapters.title: Hit the green
storyChapters.body: Mario and friends gather for a vibrant Mushroom Kingdom golf outing.

storyChapters.title: Race through the course
storyChapters.body: Speed Golf and Battle Golf turn every match into a fast-paced scramble with items and special shots.

storyChapters.title: Train to become a pro
storyChapters.body: Golf Adventure follows a Mii golfer from beginner lessons to advanced competition.

storyChapters.title: Start with Golf Adventure
storyChapters.body: New players can use Golf Adventure to learn swings, spins, terrain reading, and shot selection while gradually improving a custom golfer.

storyChapters.title: Master party-friendly and competitive modes
storyChapters.body: Beyond standard rounds, the game expands into party modes, motion control options, and competitive multiplayer that reward course knowledge.

features: Standard Golf, Speed Golf, and Battle Golf modes

Speed Golf gives the series a fresh arcade twist
Golf Adventure teaches mechanics through progression
A varied roster offers distinct shot feel and style

faq.q: Does Mario Golf: Super Rush support online play?
faq.a: Yes. The game supports online play for 2-4 players in supported modes.
Yes. Nintendo lists it as Supported – game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: What are the main special modes?
faq.a: The game highlights Speed Golf, Battle Golf, and the single-player Golf Adventure mode.

faq.q: Does Mario Golf: Super Rush support local multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. It supports local multiplayer, making it suitable for couch sessions and party-style rounds with friends or family.

faq.q: What makes it different from standard golf games?
faq.a: Its headline difference is Speed Golf, where players race across the course in real time after taking their shots, creating a much more frantic tempo.

verdictPros: Strong party value in Speed Golf and Battle Golf
Good local and online multiplayer support
Speed Golf is energetic and memorable
Easy to learn yet still satisfying to optimize
verdictCons: Adventure mode is shorter than some players expect
Some courses are simpler than sim-style golf games
Competitive balance depends heavily on character abilities
Standard golf fans may prefer more courses at launch
The RPG-style adventure mode is lighter than a full sports RPG
